summary: Dead-end kerb beside a park, but too steep and homes close.
reasons: Short 19 m kerb at street end

drivers.seclusion: Park and soccer ground to the south-west; houses 13-16 m at the north end and 19 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow dead-end street ending at parkland; kerb is 19 m and sloping, one car parked there in 2022.
drivers.convention: Residents park along the street; no signs.

flags: Dead end may be tight to turn
sun_shade: Trees shade the south end; open to the west in the afternoon.
